message.content: In one of the conversations, Li Hua mentioned a scene that stood out for him in The Witcher 3. Specifically, she highlighted the scene in the "Battle of Kaer Morhen." Li Hua noted that seeing all the characters come together against a common enemy is extremely intense, and the emotional stakes for Geralt and Yennefer make it even more powerful. This scene showcases the impact of their relationships and teamwork, making it a memorable moment in the game.
